_comment: Hinglish filler taxonomy with homograph guards. Classes: unconditional (safe anywhere), initial_or_comma (attention-getters: drop only at sentence start or comma-adjacent; not_final=true also requires the token not be the last content token), comma_or_punct (hedges: drop only when comma-adjacent), non_initial (fillers that are content at sentence start), tech_guarded (matlab: drop only lowercase and not adjacent to software-context words).
